verdict.rationale: LanceDB is Apache-2.0 open source, stores data in the Lance format on user-controlled storage (local disk or any S3-compatible object store), and uses Arrow schemas, so data is not locked into a proprietary service. Lance datasets can also be read elsewhere, such as from the Hugging Face Hub, and query results come back as arrays or Pydantic objects. However, the pack has no documented bulk-export path to other open formats (e.g. Parquet, CSV, JSON) and no migration-off guidance. missing for 10: documented full-table export to standard formats like Parquet/CSV, explicit migration/exit documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of data portability.
